name: vwap_rsi_volume_hybrid_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index drops 20+ spot points below session VWAP with RSI(36) reading below 35 (3-minute oversold exhaustion) and volume spiking 1.5x the 20-minute average, VWAP-benchmarked institutional buy programs activate aggressively — they are filling significantly better than their intraday benchmark and are incentivized to accumulate at these levels. The volume surge distinguishes a genuine panic flush (where resting bid orders absorb aggressive selling) from a slow drift away from VWAP; only the former creates a sharp mean-reversion snap. At 5-second resolution we enter on the first uptick confirming selling exhaustion, capturing the initial 10-20 spot point bounce before 1-minute bar participants can react — an entry timing advantage unavailable at coarser timeframes.

indicators.name: VWAP
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from 09:15 IST daily. No scaling needed — it is a session-cumulative measure. Provides the institutional benchmark price against which deviation is measured.

indicators.name: vwap_dist
indicators.purpose: NIFTY spot point deviation from VWAP. Original used 40 bps (≈96 NIFTY pts) on stock universe, which is too extreme to trigger frequently on NIFTY index. 20 spot pts captures moderate-to-strong intraday dislocations that occur 3-8 times per session and still trigger institutional VWAP accumulation.

indicators.name: rsi_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute RSI (36 bars × 5s). Original RSI(14) on 1-min bars = 14-minute lookback; since we hold 15-120s we need the trigger to detect exhaustion on a much shorter cycle. 36 bars (3 min) detects sharp micro-selloffs that create the reversion opportunity without being so short that it fires on every 1-2 bar wiggle. NOT 12x the original (which would be RSI(168) = 14 min), because we are trading the fast bounce, not the slow recovery.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: Current bar's volume vs 20-minute rolling average (240 bars × 5s). The 20-minute window matches the original's SMA(20) on 1-min bars (same time duration). Kept at the same time length because the purpose is capturing the session's typical pace, not scaling to hold time. A ratio > 1.5 on NIFTY at 5s resolution typically signals program trades or stop-cascade activity rather than noise.

conditions: close - VWAP < -vwap_dev_pts (index below VWAP by threshold)
vol_ratio > vol_threshold (volume spike confirms institutional activity)
close > close[i-1] (first uptick — selling exhaustion started)
buy_ce.confirmation: Uptick on current 5s bar after all three conditions met simultaneously

conditions: close - VWAP > +vwap_dev_pts (index above VWAP by threshold)
close < close[i-1] (first downtick — buying exhaustion started)
buy_pe.confirmation: Downtick on current 5s bar after all three conditions met simultaneously

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. If NIFTY continues past the exhaustion point by another 10 spots, the VWAP-reversion thesis is wrong (likely a trend day or macro shock). NIFTY 30s moves are 2-5 pts; a 5pt stop allows 2 failed bars before cutting.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts = ~16 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. From a 20pt VWAP deviation, a partial reversion of 16 spot pts captures roughly 80% of the expected mean-reversion. NIFTY 2-min moves average 5-10 option pts; 8 pts is achievable within the 120s hold window while maintaining 1:1.6 R:R.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25 (avoid extreme tail-risk days where VWAP reversion breaks down)
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST; no entries in first 5 min (09:15-09:20) pre-open noise
filters.trend_filter: No additional trend filter; VWAP deviation itself acts as regime check
filters.spread_filter: Limit order execution — no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — VWAP+RSI combination is known but triple-confirmation at 5s resolution is more specific than typical retail VWAP strategies; institutional VWAP programs that create this signal are themselves the edge source.

adaptation_notes: Three core changes from original: (1) Universe from NIFTY Next 50 stocks to NIFTY index — the original's 'thin algo coverage' edge in mid-caps is replaced by the institutional VWAP program predictability on NIFTY. (2) VWAP distance threshold changed from 40 bps (≈96 NIFTY pts, stock-specific) to 20 spot pts (calibrated for NIFTY intraday range). (3) RSI lookback compressed from 14 bars on 1-min to 36 bars on 5s (same 3-min window conceptually, NOT 12x), because we target the fast initial bounce, not the slow recovery. Volume ratio SMA kept at same 20-min time duration as original. Uptick/downtick confirmation retained from original entry logic.
weaknesses: VWAP reversion breaks down on macro-event trend days (RBI, budget) where NIFTY stays 40+ pts from VWAP for extended periods
RSI(36) at 5s can give spurious oversold readings during fast but shallow 2-3 bar dips with no real volume
Triple confirmation is restrictive — may generate only 2-4 signals per session; low trade count amplifies single-trade variance
